comment: Ticket rules, re-read on every Room load. Times are seconds. A tier's overfill is the range (fraction of on_air_time) a Ticket's gauge starts above 100%, which is how long its frequency stays silent on Stand-by. Gauge bands are listed high to low: a Ticket is in the first band whose 'above' its On Air fraction exceeds, and a Clear scores 'share' of the tier's base. Scoring reads handler_chain, lost_intercept_penalty and star_fractions.
